name: Character Evidence
author: PolyKit
description: Produces provenance-aware character proportion specifications without inventing reference measurements.

zh-CN.name: 角色证据
zh-CN.description: 生成带来源标记的角色比例规范，不伪造参考测量值。

en-US.name: Character Evidence
en-US.description: Produces provenance-aware character proportion specifications without inventing reference measurements.

nodes.name: Humanoid Proportions
nodes.description: Generates a canonical 8-head humanoid anatomy block, or attaches it to a reference-free JSON spec.

params_schema.label: Style Heads
params_schema.tooltip: Figure height expressed in head units. The complete built-in canon is 8 heads.

nodes.name: Hair Profile Audit
nodes.description: Validates scalp-bound roots, hairline controls, flow fields, representation tiers, and calibrated-value warnings.

nodes.name: Scalp Exposure Gate
nodes.description: Finds bald patches by checking whether hair points stand outside a ring-stack skull, with area-weighted coverage and exposed runs.

params_schema.label: Band From
params_schema.tooltip: Normalized scalp height at which to start checking.

params_schema.label: Band To
params_schema.tooltip: Normalized scalp height at which to stop checking.

params_schema.label: Hard Max
params_schema.tooltip: Uncalibrated exposed-area fraction above which the verdict fails.

params_schema.label: Reach
params_schema.tooltip: Optional world-unit reach; zero uses 22% of scalp height.

params_schema.label: Lateral Radius
params_schema.tooltip: Optional world-unit lateral search radius; zero uses 7.5% of scalp height.
